# Breast Cancer Literature Brief — Manually Verified Example
**Compiled:** 2026-10-17
**Status:** Source-checked manual example, **not generated by PubMed agent**. Not an approved Medical Affairs document.

Three publicly indexed randomized clinical trial publications related to HER2-positive breast cancer, selected for demonstration rather than systematic coverage.

## Paper 1: DESTINY-Breast09
- **Tolaney et al.** *N Engl J Med.* Published online 2025-10-29; issue 2026-02-05.
- **Title:** Trastuzumab Deruxtecan plus Pertuzumab for HER2-Positive Metastatic Breast Cancer
- **PMID:** 41160818; **DOI:** 10.1056/NEJMoa2508668
- **Source:** https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41160818/
- **Relevance:** Phase III research on an ADC-based regimen in metastatic HER2-positive breast cancer. Read original article to verify detailed outcomes and safety.

## Paper 2: DESTINY-Breast05
- **Loibl et al.** *N Engl J Med.* Online 2025-12-10; issue 2026-02-26.
- **Title:** Trastuzumab Deruxtecan in Residual HER2-Positive Early Breast Cancer
- **PMID:** 41370739; **DOI:** 10.1056/NEJMoa2514661
- **Source:** https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41370739/
- **Population:** Phase III trial with 1,635 randomized patients with high-risk residual HER2-positive disease.
- **Abstract result:** Invasive disease events/deaths 51/818 (6.2%) for T-DXd versus 102/817 (12.5%) for T-DM1; HR 0.47 (95% CI 0.34–0.66); three-year invasive disease-free survival 92.4% versus 83.7%.
- **Safety:** Drug-related interstitial lung disease 9.6% versus 1.6%; two ILD-related deaths in T-DXd arm.
- **Caution:** PubMed lists an April 2026 erratum. Verify correction and full source before professional use.

## Paper 3: KATHERINE long-term follow-up
- **Geyer et al.** *N Engl J Med.* 2025-01-16.
- **Title:** Survival with Trastuzumab Emtansine in Residual HER2-Positive Breast Cancer
- **PMID:** 39813643; **DOI:** 10.1056/NEJMoa2406070
- **Source:** https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/39813643/
- **Relevance:** Long-term analysis of adjuvant T-DM1 versus trastuzumab after neoadjuvant treatment in HER2-positive early breast cancer.
